1.w: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to YHWH, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. O YHWH my God, in You I have taken refuge; keep me safe from all those pursuing me, and deliver me,

2.w: lest they tear my soul like a lion, tearing apart, and there is no one snatching me up.

3.w: O YHWH my God, if I have done this, if there is injustice in my palms,

4.w: if I have dealt with the one at peace with me with evil, or have drawn out my enemy without cause,

5.w: may the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, and let him trample my life to the ground, and let him set down my honor in the dust. Selah

6.w: arise, O YHWH, in Your anger; lift up against the fury of my adversaries, and rouse Yourself for me; You have appointed a judgment.

7.w: And let the congregation of peoples surround You; and over it return in the heights.

8.w: YHWH shall judge the peoples; Judge me, O YHWH, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity within me.

9.w: Please, let the evil of the wicked cease, and may you establish the righteous—even the One testing hearts and kidneys, O Righteous God.

10.w: My shield [is] on God, the One saving the upright of heart.

11.w: God [is] a righteous judge, and a God expressing wrath on every day.

12.w: If one shall not turn back, [then] He sharpens His sword; He has bent His bow and prepared [it].

13.w: And for Himself He has prepared instruments of death; His arrows He makes into fiery shafts.

14.w: Behold, he travails [with] evil, and he conceives trouble, and brings forth falsehood.

15.w: He has dug a pit and hollowed it out, and he has fallen into a pit he has made.

16.w: His trouble shall return upon his head, and on the top of his head, his violence shall come down.

17.w: I will confess YHWH according to His righteousness, and I will sing praise [to] the name of YHWH-Elyon.
